items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The man who gave the nominating address for Hoover at the Republican convention.

ctx.x: The man who gave the nominating address for Hoover at the Republican convention. I played a Republican rally where Roscoe Simmons spellbinded those to diverge a little bit, he could talk like Adam Powell; he could spellbind the public people -- Roscoe could talk, but after he finished, nobody could remember a thing he said, but while he was saying it, it was fascinating to hear!
